items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What relation was Austin Young to Spurt? ... [INTERVIEWEE] His brother? His brother, yeah.

ctx.x: And I didn't get this straight. What relation was Austin Young to Spurt? I didn't get it. Spurt was his cousin or brother or something?

Oh, yeah, it's Lester who's the cousin I think. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Lester and the kid drummer, his name begins with an L, Leon. Leon, yeah. Lee and Lester, they're two brothers. Uh-huh. And they're cousins to the other two.
